LIGHT FLURRY: a scatter of tiny snowflakes spinning and swirling through the cold air, settling in a fine powdery dust
FAT SLOW FLAKES: big soft snowflakes drifting straight down through still air, settling silently on every ledge
FINE STEADY FALL: a thin, even curtain of small snowflakes descending in patient silence through the cold
WIND-DRIVEN SNOW: sharp granules of snow racing sideways on a bitter gust, hissing past in sheets
SNOW JUST ENDING: the last few flakes floating down slowly, the air settling into a deep cold stillness
DRIFTING SPARKLE: loose crystals lifted from the ground swirling in lazy curls through the frigid air
GROUND MIST: a knee-high white mist lying across the meadow, thinning to clear air above
VALLEY FOG: a thick fog pooled low in the valley, pressing close and muffling all movement within it
SEA FOG: a dense salt-laden fog rolling in dense and slow, softening everything it touches
MIST OVER WATER: a pale wispy mist rising from the water's surface and drifting gently inward on the air
THIN HAZE: a faint gauzy haze hanging in the air, barely visible yet softening every edge and distance
STILL AND SHARP: absolutely still cold air, so dry and clear it stings the inside of the nose
BREATH-COLD: frigid air that bites the throat and presses cold against every exposed patch of skin
DRY COLD: a desiccating cold air, clean and hard, carrying the faint mineral scent of frozen earth
CLEAR AFTER SNOW: crystalline air washed clean by snowfall, every breath sharp and deeply cold
CLEAR MOUNTAIN AIR: thin high-altitude air, dry and piercingly cold, carrying a faint mineral clarity
SOFT DRIZZLE: a fine, gentle drizzle drifting in almost-invisible droplets, making the cold air feel damp and close
STEADY RAIN: a persistent straight-down rain filling the air with a constant soft hiss and wet coolness
RAIN EASING: the last sparse drops falling wider apart, the air still heavy with cool moisture and the smell of wet earth
WET AFTER-RAIN SHINE: saturated air thick with the scent of damp soil and wet wood, cool and freshly washed
THIN SMOKE HANGING LOW: a thin transparent layer of wood-smoke clinging close to the ground, acrid and warm-scented
SMOKE LAYER ACROSS THE CLEARING: a flat drift of pale grey smoke spreading across the open air in a slow-moving band
DRIFTING RESIN HAZE: a faintly blue resinous haze carrying the sweet sharp scent of burning pine through the cool air
DUST HAZE: a fine dust hanging in and filling the dry air with a pale ochre veil, gritty on the lips
SAND HAZE: windborne sand particles hanging in the warm dry air, giving everything a soft amber blur
